_comment: bc-dhas: what a self-run participant is told about the judges' decision
(hantei) on a representative bout, shared by BOTH places that say it:
409 hantei_organiser_only message the public page shows as it is) and
web-mobile/js/admin_scoring_team.jsx (the note under a representative bout
the judges decided). The participant must read the same words whichever
side says them. It pins values, not source text. "recorded" is both the
note and the refusal once a hantei is on record; "notRecorded" is the
refusal alone, since the public sheet offers no hantei control to note.
recorded: The judges decided this representative bout (hantei). Ask the tournament organizer to change it.
notRecorded: Only the tournament organizer can record a judges' decision (hantei).
